claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black Nikon DSLR with Nikon branding, but the exact model number (D610) is not readable from the provided angles.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears.
claims.evidence: The witness did not report specific visible damage/scratches/dents; only general condition details were noted as not fully verifiable.
No photo shows included accessories (battery/charger/memory card) or what is inside the kit; accessories are listed as not shown.

risks.risk: Exact model mismatch (photos don’t confirm D610). Pricing differs a lot by model.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the camera model text/label (e.g., on the top plate or bottom plate) showing “D610”.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unconfirmed Nikon DSLR (worst-case within the shown category) with no guarantee of D610-specific value.

risks.risk: Not fully working / untested (no functional indicators or sample images shown).
risks.proof: A short video showing: power on, menu navigation, autofocus lock on a target, shutter firing, and playback of a freshly taken photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working; treat as “as-is” with reduced value.

risks.risk: Lens condition issues (fungus/haze/scratches) not visible from the provided angles.
risks.proof: Macro close-up shots of the lens front and rear glass under light, plus a test photo showing sharpness and flare/haze behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible lens wear (reduced value until lens glass is confirmed clean).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery/charger/memory card) or incomplete kit.
risks.proof: Photos laid out showing every included item: battery model label, charger, memory card, cables/strap, and any box/manual if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only or incomplete kit (worst-case) until accessories are confirmed.

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage (scratches/dents/cracked ports) affecting resale and usability.
risks.proof: Straight-on and side close-ups of: ports, buttons, hot shoe area, LCD edges, and any visible scuffs/dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for cosmetic wear until specific damage is shown.

risks.risk: High shutter count / heavy usage history.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of shutter count from-camera or via a shutter-count app (with the camera connected).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming higher usage (worst-case) until shutter count is provided.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo showing the exact model name/number “D610” on the camera body.
Video proof: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a target, shutter actuation, and playback of a newly taken image.
Macro close-ups of lens front and rear glass (under light) to check fungus/haze/scratches.
Photos of all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, memory card, cables/strap) with labels visible.
Close-ups of ports/buttons/LCD edges and any dents/scratches.
Shutter count screenshot/photo from-camera or via a shutter-count tool.
response.reason: The witness confirms it’s a Nikon DSLR, but the exact model (D610) and working condition/accessories are not verifiable from the provided photos. Without at least model confirmation and a basic functional test, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
